title: Persistence, Concurrency, and a Project Phase Assessment

questions.prompt: Which statement accurately describes iterators in Rust?

options.text: iterator adapters are generally lazy

questions.explanation: iterator adapters are generally lazy. Confirm with cargo check, Clippy, and a focused test.
